info.accent_color: Used sparingly for decoration and large text, such as journal tag marks and quote rules. Never used for small text.
info.alternate_background: Sections set to "Alternate colour" use this background, for a gentle change of rhythm down the page.
info.base_font_size: Body text size on desktop. Headings and spacing scale with it.
info.border_color: Borders, dividers and empty image placeholders. Small text uses a softened version of the text colour instead, so it always stays readable.
info.color_scheme: Used across the whole store. Each section can switch between the page colour and the alternate colour.
info.color_schemes: Four ready-made schemes: Cream, Sage, Ivory and Charcoal. Pick one below, or adjust any colour. Keep text dark on light backgrounds (or light on dark) so it stays easy to read.
info.enable_reveal: Content gently fades in as shoppers scroll. Turned off automatically for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
info.eyebrow: Short label shown above the heading in small capitals, for example NEW ARRIVALS. Leave empty to hide it.
info.fonts: Headings use Playfair Display and body text uses Work Sans. Both are included with the theme.
info.heading_style: Italic gives headings an editorial feel. You can also italicise a single word inside a heading using the italic button in rich text.
info.image_shape_global: The image shape for all product images is set once in Theme settings > Images.
info.input_corner_radius: Applies to buttons and form fields. 0 keeps sharp, classic corners.
info.product_image_shape: Used for every product image: cards, cart rows and the product gallery. Portrait (4:5) is recommended.
info.section_spacing: Vertical space above and below sections on desktop. Phones use about two thirds of this.
info.text_color: Headings, body text, buttons and the sticky add to cart bar.
info.text_on_image: Both options come from the colour scheme. Pick whichever reads best over your image.
info.button_label: Used on the product panel button and the sticky bar. Leave empty to use the default "Add to cart" text.
info.comments: Comments show only when they're turned on for this blog in Shopify admin (Online Store > Blog posts > Manage blogs).
info.contact_form: Adds a contact form under the page text. Messages are sent to your store's email address. The "page.contact" template has this turned on: pick it for your Contact page in Shopify admin.
info.display_name: Leave empty to use the collection's name.
info.featured_collection: Until you pick a collection, four sample pieces with built-in images show. Shoppers see them too, so choose a collection before launching.
info.featured_journal: Leave empty to use your store's default blog (News). Until the blog has posts, three sample stories with built-in images show.
info.featured_post: Shows the newest post large at the top of the first page, when no tag is chosen.
info.filters: Choose which filters appear, such as size or colour, in Shopify's free Search & Discovery app.
info.image_portrait: Portrait image, recommended 1600 × 2000 px (4:5). Until you choose one, the theme's built-in photo of hands folding linen shows.
info.sample_rating: Sample rating and review count for now. A reviews app can show real reviews later.
info.sample_reviews: Sample reviews for now. A reviews app can show real reviews later. The average rating and total are worked out from the star counts.
info.write_review_link: Leave empty to link to your Contact page.
info.filter_topics: Topics separated by commas, for example Size, Fit. Shoppers can filter reviews by these.
info.review_date: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-02.
info.review_topics: Topics this review covers, separated by commas, for example Size, Fit.
info.sample_cart: Shoppers never see the sample item. It shows only in the theme editor while your cart is empty, so you can style the page.
info.sample_collection: Shoppers never see the sample filters or products. They show only in the theme editor while a collection has no products, so you can style the page.
info.sample_amount: In your store's currency, for example 89 or 4.5.
info.sample_product: Pick a product to show it here. Until then, the sample name and price show with a placeholder image.
info.image_banner: Wide image with an empty left side for the text, recommended 2400 × 1340 px. Until you choose one, the theme's built-in linen flat-lay shows.
info.default_image: One of the theme's built-in images. Shows only until you choose your own image above, or the collection has an image of its own. Automatic picks one by the tile's position.
info.countries: Two-letter country codes separated by commas, for example GB, IE. Leave empty to make this the default chart for every other country.
info.header_icons: The account icon shows only when customer accounts are turned on. The cart icon always shows the number of items in the cart.
info.label_default: Leave empty to use the default text.
info.logo_text: Shown as the store name in the header. Leave empty to use your Shopify store name.
info.market_selector: Lets shoppers pick their country or region and currency. Shows when you sell to more than one market in Shopify settings.
info.newsletter: Sign ups are saved as customers tagged "newsletter" in Shopify admin.
info.password_message: The message under the heading comes from Shopify admin: Online Store > Preferences > Password protection.
info.payment_icons: Icons for your active payment methods. Until payments are set up, a placeholder shows in the theme editor only.
info.placeholder_count: Number of placeholder boxes shown when a product has no images yet.
info.product_filter: Product types or tags separated by commas, for example Dresses, Tops. Leave empty to use this chart for all products.
info.rows: One row per line. Separate cells with |. The first line is the heading row. Start each row with the size name exactly as it appears on the product, for example M. Columns with bust, chest, waist or hip in the heading get a box where shoppers type their own measurement to find their size.
info.size_chart: Shoppers see the chart listing their country. If none matches, they see the chart with no countries.
info.size_chart_note: Optional text under the chart, such as how to measure or which unit is used.
info.size_option_name: The product option that holds sizes. The size guide link appears under it.
info.suggestions_count: Products shown under the empty cart message. Set to 0 to turn them off.
info.suggestions_count_404: Products shown under the message. Set to 0 to turn them off.
info.text_under_checkout: Optional. For example, delivery times or how returns work.
info.tile_image: Optional. Replaces the collection's own image on this tile. Recommended 1200 × 1500 px for portrait tiles.
info.sticky_bar: A bar fixed to the bottom of the screen with the product name, selected size, price and add to cart button.
info.variant_picker: Shows each product option, such as size or colour, as buttons. Option names and values come from the product in Shopify admin.
